page_title: RSO 5-3 GRA | Real Sociedad v Granada CF 02/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+11' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+9' 5 - 3 Bryan Zaragoza (Granada CF) takes a great first touch to control a killer pass on the edge of the box and fires the ball into the roof of the net in trademark fashion.
90+7' One of the players from Real Sociedad times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
90+6' Mohamed-Ali Cho (Real Sociedad) blasts the ball high over the crossbar.

90+5' Umar Sadiq (Real Sociedad) received a precise low pass and attempted to surprise the keeper with a quick execution. A superb strike only denied by the right post. The ball goes out of play and Granada CF will have a goal kick.
90+4' Lucas Boye (Granada CF) blasts the ball high over the crossbar.
90+2' 13:13 – this is the current number of fouls committed by both teams.
90' 9 additional min. will be played.
89' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Granada CF.

89' Granada CF are playing some nice combination football, sending it precisely from player to player, but a defender shows good anticipation and ends the move with a good block. The linesman makes the right call and Granada CF will have a corner.
88' Mohamed-Ali Cho (Real Sociedad) is adjudged offside.
86' Bryan Zaragoza (Granada CF) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
84' 5 - 2 Goal! Great play by Antonio Puertas releases Lucas Boye (Granada CF) in space on the edge of the box. He spots the keeper off his line and coolly puts the ball into bottom left corner. 5:2.
82' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Benat Turrientes (Real Sociedad) comes onto the pitch for Mikel Merino.
80' Umar Sadiq (Real Sociedad) blasts the ball high over the crossbar.
79' Substitution. Gonzalo Villar (Granada CF) in, Gerard Gumbau out.
79' Imanol Alguacil prepares a substitution. Ander Barrenetxea is replaced by Arsen Zakharyan (Real Sociedad).
78' Imanol Alguacil decides to make a substitution. Takefusa Kubo will be replaced by Mohamed-Ali Cho (Real Sociedad).
78' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Mikel Oyarzabal departs the field of play to be replaced by Umar Sadiq (Real Sociedad).
76' 5 - 1 Miki Bosch (Granada CF) scores an unfortunate own goal and the opposition increase their lead!
76' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
75' The ball is cleared after Myrto Uzuni (Granada CF) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Real Sociedad.
74' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Granada CF was in an offside position.

71' Oscar Melendo (Granada CF) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Javier Iglesias Villanueva with no other option than to blow for a foul.
69' Imanol Alguacil has decided to substitute Kieran Tierney and he is replaced by Aihen Munoz (Real Sociedad).

68' 4 - 1 Goal! That was a fantastic finish by Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) from just outside the box. He wasted little time in getting away a bullet of a shot that flew past the goalkeeper into the bottom left corner of the net.
66' Substitution. Sergio Ruiz is replaced by Oscar Melendo (Granada CF).
66' Here's the change. Miguel Rubio leaves the pitch and Miki Bosch (Granada CF) comes on as a substitute.
66' Here is a change. Jose Callejon is going off and Paco Lopez gives the last tactical orders to Antonio Puertas (Granada CF).
66' The referee signals a substitution. Ricard Sanchez (Granada CF) is brought on as a substitute for Victor Diaz.
64' Lucas Boye (Granada CF) rises above the defenders and places a towering header towards the middle of the goal, but Alex Remiro is prepared to thwart his effort.
63' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) gets there first and whips in a shot at goal that flies just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Granada CF will have a goal kick.
61' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Javier Iglesias Villanueva saw the whole situation.

59' 3 - 1 Goal! Great play by Brais Mendez releases Martin Zubimendi (Real Sociedad) in space on the edge of the box. He spots the keeper off his line and coolly puts the ball into the right side of the goal. 3:1.
57' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) threads a pass through the eye of a needle into the box for Mikel Oyarzabal, but Raul Fernandez displays great awareness to stop him.
56' One of the Real Sociedad players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
54' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
54' The referee is firm and issues Victor Diaz (Granada CF) a deserved yellow card.
53' The current number of fouls conceded by both teams is 8:9.
53' Sergio Ruiz (Granada CF) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Javier Iglesias Villanueva had an easy-decision to make.
51' Kieran Tierney (Real Sociedad) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
51' The ball possession at the moment is 65:35.
49' Granada CF take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
48' Granada CF can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield. The ball goes out of play. Granada CF are awarded a corner kick.
48' Granada CF are passing the ball across the pitch and keep possession. However, an opponent intercepts a pass and the situation changes. It will be a corner kick for Granada CF.
47' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
46' Referee Javier Iglesias Villanueva blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+5' The match has reached half-time.
45+4' Lucas Boye (Granada CF) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
45+2' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) receives a lofted pass from the side and shoots from around the penalty spot, but the ball flies slightly wide, almost brushing the left-hand post.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
44' 2 - 1 Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) breaks through the defence and scores a brilliant goal from outside the penalty area after firing the ball inside the left post!
41' Referee Javier Iglesias Villanueva sees the trip by Mikel Merino (Real Sociedad) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
39' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Lucas Boye (Granada CF) was quite harsh and Javier Iglesias Villanueva didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
36' 1 - 1 It's an own goal! Robin Le Normand (Real Sociedad) scores into his own net!
36' Gerard Gumbau (Granada CF) will take the corner.

35' Granada CF move the ball around well as they wait for an opportunity to shoot, but the attack is halted as they lose possession. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Granada CF will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
34' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
33' PENALTY APPEAL by Real Sociedad, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
33' Bryan Zaragoza (Granada CF) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
31' Hamari Traore (Real Sociedad) blasts the ball high over the crossbar.
29' The fouls committed statistics – 4:5.
29' Martin Zubimendi (Real Sociedad) commits a rough challenge and Javier Iglesias Villanueva blows his whistle for a foul.
27' Granada CF are ruled offside.
27' Carlos Neva (Granada CF) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
26' Granada CF are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
25' Gerard Gumbau (Granada CF) is penalised for a foul. Javier Iglesias Villanueva had a clear view and blows his whistle.
24' Jose Callejon (Granada CF) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
23' Real Sociedad take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

23' Real Sociedad play a few nice passes from player to player, but their possession doesn't last long as an opposition player intercepts a pass. The ball goes out for a corner. Real Sociedad can continue in their attacking effort.
22' Ignasi Miquel (Granada CF) has tested the patience of referee Javier Iglesias Villanueva and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
17' The possession of the ball – 72:28.
16' Great teamplay by Real Sociedad as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
14' Sergio Ruiz (Granada CF) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
13' A defence splitting pass into the box is almost received by Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad), but Raul Fernandez is quick enough and comes off his line to intercept the pass.
12' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Real Sociedad comes to nothing.
11' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear. Real Sociedad will take a corner kick.
10' Lucas Boye (Granada CF) is flagged for offside.
9' 1 - 0 Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) scores! He latches on to a pass and produces a perfect strike from the edge of the box. The ball goes into the bottom right corner and past the goalkeeper.
9' 68:32 – the ratio of ball possession.
8' Lucas Boye (Granada CF) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
6' Lucas Boye (Granada CF) makes a rough challenge and Javier Iglesias Villanueva blows his whistle for a foul.
5' Real Sociedad control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
3' The corner is swung in but Real Sociedad can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
3' Real Sociedad are enjoying possession, but one of the opposition players steps in to end the sequence. Real Sociedad force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
2' Gerard Gumbau (Granada CF) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Javier Iglesias Villanueva blows for a foul.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Real Sociedad will kick-off.
Javier Iglesias Villanueva is the one to supervise the game today.
